title: Live meeting: never lose spoken words without telling the host
summary: The meeting screen now says when spoken words are lost or delayed: an ended capture track stops Record with a reason, a 'transcription is behind' line shows when slices queue, a stuck slice drops only itself (a fresh speech-model copy takes the next slice), agents get nothing until Claude Code is ready, and terminal Enter waits for the typed echo.
friction: The merge gate went red twice on a 5-second timeout in resources/skills/grillo-meeting/grillo-meeting.test.ts (the test forks Git Bash many times) while another project's Playwright tests held the CPU at 80-100%; the gate lock only serialises Grillo runs, so about 30 minutes went to two red runs and waiting for the other project to finish.
lessons_learned: Fakes for the speech engine must run one call at a time like whisper.node (one native lock per context, a running call cannot be aborted); fakes that ran calls side by side hid the outlier-clock bug through two review rounds.
